github.summary: Smarter scheduling, clearer workforce planning, and more useful dashboard snapshots.

changelog.title: Capacity-aware shift templates
changelog.details: Build shifts with capacity context and spot conflicts before publishing.

popup.title: Build shifts with capacity context
popup.description: Preview conflicts while creating shift templates.

changelog.title: Safer recurring schedule edits
changelog.description: Keep exception dates intact when editing recurring schedules.
changelog.details: Recurring schedule changes preserve dates that were already customized.

changelog.title: Skills and availability filters
changelog.description: Find the right people faster when assigning work.
changelog.details: Filter assignments by the skills and availability needed for each shift.

popup.title: Find the right people faster
popup.description: Filter assignments by skills and availability.

changelog.title: Split-shift overtime totals
changelog.description: Recalculate overtime totals after split shifts are edited.
changelog.details: Overtime totals now reflect edits made to each part of a split shift.

changelog.title: Staffing gap snapshots
changelog.description: Surface staffing gaps earlier in team snapshots.
changelog.details: Team snapshots bring emerging staffing gaps into view sooner.

popup.title: See staffing gaps earlier
popup.description: Team snapshots now surface emerging staffing gaps sooner.

changelog.title: Timezone-accurate dashboard exports
changelog.description: Match exported dates to the selected timezone.
changelog.details: Dashboard exports now use the timezone selected for the view.

changelog.title: Release verification diagnostics
changelog.description: Refresh background-job diagnostics and test fixtures.
changelog.details: Background-job diagnostics and test fixtures now provide clearer release verification signals.
